sections.heading: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
sections.body: ==Quality Automation Specialist== with **15+ years** of test automation and QA architecture expertise across enterprise, financial services, and high-scale platforms. ==Designed and delivered end-to-end automation frameworks== covering **1,200+ test cases** while ==leveraging AI-driven testing methodologies== and Generative AI to enhance test coverage and accuracy. Proven leader in ==building predictive and intelligent testing approaches== aligned to business outcomes and regulatory compliance.

roles.title: ==TEST AUTOMATION ENGINEER / ASSOCIATE CONSULTANT & TEST LEAD==
roles.meta: Jun 2018 – Present | Noida, India | Enterprise Web & API Platforms
bullets: ==Design and evolve automation test strategies== aligned to business and compliance goals, improving control, accuracy, and integrity across delivery models.

==Architected Selenium/Java/TestNG/Cucumber automation framework== using data-driven and BDD patterns with **500+ test cases**, ==growing automated coverage from 30% to 80%== and enabling predictable release cycles.

==Built parallel Playwright/JavaScript-TypeScript automation suite with ~700+ test cases==, enabling daily regression runs and ==cutting release-testing time by 70%==, demonstrating scalable test-design patterns reusable across domains.
==Integrated Selenium and Playwright suites into Jenkins and GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines==, establishing automated quality gates for continuous integration and defect-free deployment.
==Leveraged Generative AI, LLMs, and Prompt Engineering== to accelerate test design, test analysis, and QA automation activities, implementing ==AI-assisted test generation and planning== approaches.
==Automated API testing== (SOAP UI, Postman) and ==validated backend data integrity via complex SQL Server/DB2 scripting==, ensuring data-quality compliance across critical business workflows.
==Mentored and upskilled team of 10+ QA engineers== on automation frameworks, Agile methodologies, and intelligent testing approaches, fostering a quality-focused culture.
